parts.name: tube body

physics.Basic_description: Salmon-pink cylindrical handle forming the lower half of the container, matte plastic finish.
physics.Functional_description: Main housing for the lipstick mechanism and primary grip point for the user.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical body firmly from the sides to stabilize the object during manipulation.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic container wall enclosing empty space for the mechanism.

parts.description: Salmon-pink cylindrical handle forming the lower half of the container, matte plastic finish.
parts.function: Main housing for the lipstick mechanism and primary grip point for the user.

parts.name: center band

physics.Basic_description: Thin green ring segment located at the junction between the handle and the upper mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Decorative band or structural reinforcement at the pivot point of the handle.
physics.Grasped_description: Too narrow and recessed to be a primary grasp point; avoid gripping here to prevent slippage.
physics.reason: Likely a solid insert or thickened rib within the assembly rather than a hollow shell.

parts.description: Thin green ring segment located at the junction between the handle and the upper mechanism.
parts.function: Decorative band or structural reinforcement at the pivot point of the handle.

parts.name: hinge lug

physics.Basic_description: Small blue rectangular protrusion at the top rim of the tube body.
physics.Functional_description: Structural lug that houses the pin for the hinged cap mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal mechanical feature; not suitable for grasping.
physics.reason: Small structural feature requiring solidity to withstand hinge forces.

parts.description: Small blue rectangular protrusion at the top rim of the tube body.
parts.function: Structural lug that houses the pin for the hinged cap mechanism.

parts.name: carrier cup

physics.Basic_description: Internal yellow component visible at the hinge junction, likely the base of the bullet holder.
physics.Functional_description: Cup that holds the lipstick bullet and connects to the twisting mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component; not accessible for external grasping.
physics.reason: Cup shape designed to hold material, implying thin walls around a cavity.

parts.description: Internal yellow component visible at the hinge junction, likely the base of the bullet holder.
parts.function: Cup that holds the lipstick bullet and connects to the twisting mechanism.

parts.name: bullet red

physics.Basic_description: Small orange/red tip visible at the center hinge, representing the lipstick product or a pivot pin.
physics.Functional_description: The cosmetic product itself or a central pivot element within the mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and centrally located to be grasped effectively.
physics.reason: If representing wax/product, it is solid; if a pin, it is solid metal/plastic.

parts.description: Small orange/red tip visible at the center hinge, representing the lipstick product or a pivot pin.
parts.function: The cosmetic product itself or a central pivot element within the mechanism.

parts.name: twist marker

physics.Basic_description: Tiny purple detail near the hinge base, likely an alignment mark or screw cover.
physics.Functional_description: Visual indicator for assembly or operation alignment.
physics.reason: Small surface detail or insert, treated as solid mass.

parts.description: Tiny purple detail near the hinge base, likely an alignment mark or screw cover.
parts.function: Visual indicator for assembly or operation alignment.

parts.name: cap shell

physics.Basic_description: Large salmon-pink component comprising the rounded top cap and the flared conical skirt below the hinge.
physics.Functional_description: Protective cover for the lipstick bullet and the upper structural housing of the device.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the conical skirt or the rounded top to open/close the hinge or manipulate the upper assembly.
physics.reason: Molded plastic shell enclosing air cavity to fit over the tube body.

parts.description: Large salmon-pink component comprising the rounded top cap and the flared conical skirt below the hinge.
parts.function: Protective cover for the lipstick bullet and the upper structural housing of the device.

parts.name: hinge knuckle

physics.Basic_description: Small magenta cylindrical feature at the edge of the cap skirt, forming the other half of the hinge.
physics.Functional_description: Knuckle that interlocks with the tube lug to allow the cap to pivot open and closed.
physics.Grasped_description: Mechanical joint feature; not a stable grasp point.
physics.reason: Hinge knuckles require structural integrity and are typically solid or thick-walled to prevent breaking.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
